basic_profile.bio: I'm a passionate ornithologist based in Leeds, UK, who loves sharing knowledge about bird species and their conservation. My day job involves working as a public health consultant, focusing on community health initiatives, especially around epilepsy awareness. When I'm not working or birdwatching, I love spending time in the local park with my dog and attending local board game meetups. I tend to browse Reddit in the evenings, usually between 7 PM and 10 PM. Happily married with two kids, and we often enjoy family game nights.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I hold a degree in Public Health and have amassed extensive knowledge in ornithology through years of birdwatching and participating in bird conservation projects. My public health expertise is complemented by my hands-on experience in community health programs, particularly those related to epilepsy.
